_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill in what you need. Everything is optional — with an empty config the local desktop dock works fully. config.json is git-ignored, so your secrets never get committed.
_web_password_note: Set this to log in and control sessions remotely WITHOUT Telegram (over HTTPS). Empty = off; the local PC (127.0.0.1) always has control.
_vps_note: Optional: adds a 🖥 VPS button to Launch that runs `claude -p --model opus|sonnet` on your server over SSH (headless -> result to Telegram) or opens an interactive session. The server authenticates Claude on its own (its `claude login` / ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) — do NOT put any API key here. Uses key-based SSH. If you connect as root, set `run_user` to a NON-root user that has `claude` logged in, because Claude refuses --dangerously-skip-permissions under root.
